opinions.text: C. A. 8th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 524 U. S. 915.] Motion of respondents John W. Thompson et al. for divided argument granted to be divided as follows: 20 minutes for Minnesota and 10 minutes for respondents John W. Thompson et al. Request for additional time for oral argument denied. Motion of the Solicitor General for divided argument granted.
